records.body:
# Hologram Model Hub

Open models. Every object is named by the BLAKE3 hash of its bytes; every model file by its SHA-256. Fetch from anywhere, check it yourself, trust no host.

## The short way (use the tools you already have)

- Any Hugging Face tool: `export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hub.uor.foundation`, then `hf download <owner>/<name>` (or `snapshot_download`, `from_pretrained`, `llama-server -hf`…

info.title: Hologram Live API
info.description: Extensible local and remote module host for Hologram

next_cursor.description: Absent when the walk reached the end of the result set.

truncated.description:
True when a provider-side scan bound stopped the walk before `limit`
was satisfied. A capped result is never presented as a complete one.

ObjectQuery.description:
A search over stored objects.

Every field is an independent conjunctive filter; `None` means "do not
constrain". Ordering is ascending by object id, identically for every
provider: a remote tag listing arrives in lexical order, and imposing a
time ordering on it would mean enumerating everything before returning the
first page.

cursor.description:
Opaque, and valid only for the provider that issued it. A structured
cursor would leak provider internals into a public API and stop either
side changing independently.

result.instructions: Open models, every file named by its SHA-256. search_models to find one, get_model for its files, resolve_file for a download URL with the hash it must have. Weights are fetched by your shell or engine, never through a tool result.

headers.access-control-expose-headers: mcp-protocol-version

tools.name: search_models
tools.title: Search models
tools.description: Find open models in the hub's index. Every result has all of its files addressed by SHA-256. Returns id, task, library, licence, parameters, weight size, downloads and where the bytes live.

query.description: Part of the model id, e.g. 'qwen' or 'whisper'.

task.description: Hugging Face pipeline tag, e.g. text-generation, text-to-speech, feature-extraction.

license.description: SPDX-style licence id, e.g. apache-2.0, mit.

max_weights_gb.description: Upper bound on the total size of the weights.

tools.name: get_model
tools.title: Get a model
tools.description: The pinned revision of one model, its files with size and SHA-256, its GGUF quantisations if any, and its sources with their current health.

tools.name: resolve_file
tools.title: Resolve a file
tools.description: Where to download one file of a model right now, the SHA-256 it must have, how to check it, and the commands that hand it to an engine (hf, Ollama, llama.cpp). Give either a path or, for GGUF models, a quantisation such as Q4_K_M.
